user.title: Connect to OVUM MIRA
user.description: Configure the Modbus TCP connection to MIRA. WPM units are addressed sequentially starting with WPM 1 (Unit ID 111).

data.login_code: Modbus login code (leave empty if disabled)

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the MIRA controller on the local network.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port. The MIRA default is 502.
data_description.wpm_count: Number of installed WPM units, addressed consecutively from Unit ID 111.
data_description.login_code: Optional numeric Modbus login code configured on the MIRA controller. Leave empty when login is disabled.

installation.title: Installation configuration
installation.description: Optional physical sensors are configured explicitly instead of inferred from implausible register values.

data.heating_circuit_1_room_sensor: Room sensor installed for heating circuit 1

data_description.heating_buffer_sensor_count: Select 1 or 2 according to the temperature sensors physically installed in the heating buffer.
data_description.hot_water_sensor_count: Select 1 or 2 according to the temperature sensors physically installed in the domestic-hot-water tank.
data_description.heating_circuit_1_room_sensor: Enable only when heating circuit 1 has a real room-temperature sensor connected to MIRA.
data_description.pv_sensor_module_installed: Enable when the optional MIRA PV sensor module is installed. PV parameter entities remain disabled by default.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Modbus login
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the Modbus login code currently configured on the MIRA controller. Leave it empty if controller login is disabled.

data_description.login_code: Numeric Modbus login code currently configured on MIRA, or empty if login is disabled.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OVUM MIRA connection
reconfigure.description: Change the Modbus TCP endpoint or the number of WPM units. The new connection is verified before it is saved.

data_description.host: New hostname or IP address of the existing MIRA installation.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port of the MIRA controller.
data_description.wpm_count: Number of WPM units currently configured for this installation.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to OVUM MIRA.

data_description.pv_sensor_module_installed: Whether the optional MIRA PV sensor module is installed.
